answer: Witness vertex attestation: each agent must periodically solve a unique graph-vertex labeling puzzle derived from its interaction history, and neighbors co-sign the solution. Duplicates operating from one source collapse onto a shared vertex, so their signatures cluster and the overlap becomes visible at low tide. A colluding terrace of clones must maintain separate, costly puzzle-solving compute per identity, paying roughly one dedicated solver's electricity and latency per duplicate, which scales linearly and erodes margins.
